summary.text: Thomas Hendrickson is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 3rd Hampden District in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Republican Nicholas Boldyga and unenrolled candidate Jason Perron.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served on the Agawam City Council since 2022.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Hendrickson earned a high school diploma from Agawam High School, a bachelor's degree from Providence College in 2021, and a graduate degree from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 2022, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working in government affairs.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Hendrickson said he is the son of two public school teachers and that, as an Agawam city councilor, he passed legislation requiring committee meetings to be recorded and publicly released.
He listed his campaign priorities as a fairer economy for working-class families, government transparency and accountability, and reproductive and LGBTQ rights.
